title: pane layout
description: A grid of slots seat.sh renders into one herdr tab (SPEC-04 s-labels). Labels and commands take ${MODEL} ${effort} ${ticket} ${seat} ${name} ${state_dir} ${worktree} ${repo}. One slot of kind agent per seat layout; none in a monitors layout.

pre_start.description: Shell lines typed into the agent pane, in order, after the environment line and before the agent starts; each must finish (seat.sh waits for it) and takes the same tokens as a command plus ${agent_pane}. Run only when the agent is started, never on a repair of a live seat.

command.description: run once in a fresh pane; empty for the agent slot and for a shell
